Operations Center. -
An Operations Center is hereby
created, based at the DOE. The Operations Center sllall be headed by an
Executive Director, with the rank of Undersecretary whose designation shall be
approved by tile President. The personnel of the Operations Center shall be
recruited and contributed by members of the PTF-SEFEELS,to be designated by
the Chair with the approval of the President.
Deactivation
of the National Anti-Environment
Task Force. - The National Anti-Environment Crime Task Force (NAECTAF)
created under the PAOCCthrough ExecutiveOrder (EO) No. 515 issued on March
15, 2006 is hereby deactivated. All personnel and assets assigned to NAECTAF
shall be transferred to the PTF-SEFEELS.
Assistance.
- All departments:
agencies, offices or
instrumentalities: including government-owned or controlled corporations, are
hereby directed to provide support, assistanceand resourcesto the PTF-SEFEELS
in the dischargeof its functions.

Department of
